description: Send an email from a verified domain (POST /emails). Give html and/or text, or a published template.

from.description: Sender, e.g. "Acme <orders@example.com>"; optional when the template sets one

idempotency_key.description: Makes retries safe: the same key never sends twice

template_id.description: A published template id or alias, instead of html/text

to.description: Recipient address or up to 50 addresses

name: send_email
